label: Diagram 40
caption: Diagram 40 Free areas of permanently open air vents for oil-fired appliance installations
description: Diagram 40 is a table of small floor plans showing free areas of permanently open air vents for oil-fired appliance installations. It has three rows and two columns headed “Open flued” and “Room sealed”. The left column labels the rows: “Appliance in a room or space”, “Appliance in an appliance compartment ventilated via an adjoining room or space”, and “Appliance in an appliance compartment ventilated direct to outside”. Each cell holds a plan of a room or compartment, the appliance drawn as a rectangle with a flue or pipe line, and wall gaps marked with letters. Values per kW output are: row one, A = 550mm² (open flued) and “No vent needed” (room sealed); row two, A = 550mm², B = 1100mm², C = 1650mm² (open flued) and F = 1100mm², G = F (room sealed); row three, D = 550mm², E = 1100mm² (open flued) and H = 550mm², I = H (room sealed). Five numbered notes below state which letters are permanently open vents to the outside and which are between an appliance compartment and a room or space, that the given area is the free area of the vent(s) or the equivalent free area for ventilators of more complex design, the draught-break addition, the mm²-to-cm² conversion, and the 5kW(net) proviso for older dwellings.
